sections.text_helper: Section 9.8.13 "RCC APB2 peripheral reset register (RCC_APB2RSTR)" in chapter 9 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 294.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x07C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:25 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 24 USBRST: USB reset
Set and reset by software.
0: USB not reset (default after reset)
1: USB reset
Bits 23:19 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 18 TIM17RST: TIM17 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: TIM17 not reset (default after reset)
1: TIM17 reset
Bit 17 TIM16RST: TIM16 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: TIM16 not reset (default after reset)
1: TIM16 reset
Bit 16 TIM15RST: TIM15 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: TIM15 not reset (default after reset)
1: TIM15 reset
Bit 15 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 14 USART1RST: USART1 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: USART1 not reset (default after reset)
1: USART1 reset
Bit 13 TIM8RST: TIM8 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: TIM8 not reset (default after reset)
1: TIM8 reset
Bit 12 SPI1RST: SPI1 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: SPI1 not reset (default after reset)
1: SPI1 reset
Bit 11 TIM1RST: TIM1 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: TIM1 not reset (default after reset)
1: TIM1 reset
Bits 10:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
